scripts.prestart: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.dev: rimraf dist && tsc && cross-env FORCE_COLOR=1 concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names "typescript,functions,azurite" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta,blue" "tsc -w" "func start" "azurite --silent --location .azurite --debug .azurite/debug.log"
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test dist/test/status.test.js dist/test/mobile-status.test.js
